CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2627 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 48e8c29b7ffe23df442d563b7ae81d81e7475d4e. Bus nonce: fe39a9af50baca9487d87c76abdfe040. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 48e8c29b7ffe23df442d563b7ae81d81e7475d4e`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 48e8c29b7ffe23df442d563b7ae81d81e7475d4e` or `Fix review: blocked 48e8c29b7ffe23df442d563b7ae81d81e7475d4e <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: fe39a9af50baca9487d87c76abdfe040`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `48e8c29b7ffe23df442d563b7ae81d81e7475d4e` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2627 48e8c29b7ffe23df442d563b7ae81d81e7475d4e") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2627-fe39a9af`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2627 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), group R10-NIGHTLY-ABSENT-NEW (IN lane, instrument, opus). Round 2. Head 48e8c29b7ffe23df442d563b7ae81d81e7475d4e. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at that head. Use the finder harness the group brief names, never the fixer harness. Read the group entry with `git show origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json`.

What round 2 did (verify, do not trust): f4a3ea954 reverts the fixer's own roster edit; the PR body was fixed; its CI-LAYOUT-P2 carry is landed on the roster at 0f690a952102eb8840d86764f1fbbf2d8d4d1bf1, and the body names it.

Verify:
1. The NEW/ABSENT window against the brief's control at the merge base: a workflow younger than its first cron slot is NEW, not ABSENT; a workflow past that window with no scheduled run is still ABSENT. Both arms exercised, measured at the merge base and at the head.
2. The branch's diff no longer touches dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json (`git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD --stat` must not list it).
3. The carry is on the roster at 0f690a952102eb8840d86764f1fbbf2d8d4d1bf1 as the group's carry (CI-LAYOUT-P2), with wording matching the finding, and the PR body names that SHA.
Re-read the head before you start; a moved head is a blocked verdict.

Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
